# Event Stories: Party Planner - Complete Information

> Event Stories is a comprehensive, free iOS app designed for planning events, parties, weddings, corporate gatherings, and celebrations of all kinds. It provides tools for guest list management, budget tracking, schedule coordination, vendor organization, and professional PDF report generation.

## App Overview

- **App Name**: Event Stories: Party Planner
- **Developer**: Robert Jensen
- **Company**: 12f
- **Contact Email**: robert@12f.dk
- **Website**: https://event-stories.12f.dk

- **App Store ID**: 6755695151
- **Bundle ID**: 12f.event-stories

## Platform & Requirements

- **Platform**: iOS (iPhone)
- **Minimum iOS Version**: 17.0
- **Price**: Free
- **In-App Purchases**: Premium Lifetime upgrade available
- **Categories**: Productivity, Lifestyle
- **Age Rating**: 4+

## Detailed Features

### Guest List Management
Track RSVPs with status tracking (invited, confirmed, declined, maybe). Manage contact information, dietary requirements, allergies, plus-ones, and table/seating arrangements. Import contacts and keep your guest list organized and up-to-date across all your events.

### Budget Tracking
Visualize your event expenses by category with clear charts. Track payments to vendors, monitor spending against your set budget, and see your remaining budget at a glance. Categorize expenses and keep financial oversight of your entire event.

### Schedule & Timeline
Create detailed event-day schedules and planning timelines. Integrate with maps for venue and vendor locations. Coordinate activities, set reminders, and ensure everything runs on time. Perfect for multi-day events and weddings.

### Vendor Management
Organize all your vendor contacts, contracts, and communications in one centralized place. Track vendor costs, payment status, and important details. Quick access to vendor phone numbers, emails, and addresses.

### PDF Export & Reporting
Generate professional PDF reports that include your complete guest list, budget summary, vendor contacts, and event schedule. Share these reports with co-planners, vendors, wedding coordinators, or your event team. Perfect for collaborative planning.

### iCloud Sync
Your events automatically sync across all your Apple devices via iCloud. Start planning on your iPhone at home and access everything at the venue. Changes are reflected in real-time across devices.

### Offline Support
Event Stories is designed to work fully offline. Access your events, guest lists, budgets, and schedules even without internet access. Perfect for venue visits, outdoor events, or anywhere with limited connectivity.

### Photo Documentation
Capture and organize event photos and memories. Document venue visits, decoration inspiration, and event-day moments. Keep everything related to your event in one app.

### Task Management
Create to-do lists and planning checklists for your events. Track task completion, set priorities, and never miss an important preparation step.

## Use Cases

Event Stories is ideal for:
- **Weddings**: Full wedding planning with guest lists, vendor management, budget tracking, and day-of timeline
- **Birthday Parties**: Guest management, budget oversight, and activity scheduling
- **Corporate Events**: Professional event coordination with PDF reports for stakeholders
- **Holiday Gatherings**: Family event organization with dietary tracking and seating plans
- **Baby Showers & Celebrations**: Gift tracking, guest RSVPs, and activity planning
- **Fundraisers & Galas**: Budget management, sponsor tracking, and attendee lists

## How It Works

1. **Create Your Event**: Set up your event with a name, date, budget, and details
2. **Build Your Guest List**: Add guests, track RSVPs, manage dietary needs and seating
3. **Track Your Budget**: Monitor spending by category with visual charts
4. **Coordinate Vendors & Schedule**: Manage vendor contacts and create event timelines
5. **Export & Share**: Generate PDF reports to share with your team

## Frequently Asked Questions

### Is Event Stories free to use?
Yes, Event Stories is free to download and use. We also offer a Premium Lifetime upgrade with more advanced features for serious event planners who want the complete toolkit.

### Does the app work offline?
Absolutely! Event Stories is designed to work fully offline so you can access your events, guest lists, and budgets even without internet access. This is perfect for venue visits and outdoor events.

### Can I share events with others?
Yes! With iCloud sync, your events stay up to date across your Apple devices. You can also export professional PDF reports to share with co-planners, vendors, or your event team via email, messaging, or any sharing method.

### How do I export reports?
Simply open your event, tap the export button, and choose PDF. Event Stories generates a professional report with your guest list, budget summary, vendor contacts, and schedule. You can then share it via any standard iOS sharing option.

### What devices are supported?
Event Stories is currently available for iPhone and requires iOS 17.0 or later. We're focused on delivering the best possible experience on iOS first.

## Technical Details

- **Data Storage**: All data is stored locally on-device with optional iCloud sync
- **Privacy**: No personal data is collected or shared with third parties
- **Analytics**: Anonymous usage analytics only (via privacy-focused Umami)
- **No Ads**: The app contains no advertisements
- **No Tracking**: No user tracking or profiling
